technical_and_design_decisions: Target environment is a Spring-based enterprise stream/batch data processing architecture (Spring Cloud Data Flow / Spring Cloud Stream family).
Mesos SPI update will introduce an explicitly mapped 'UNDEPLOYED' state in the deployer status enum/mapper to replace ambiguous 'UNKNOWN' states during teardown or initial deployment phases.
Rabbit Bus cleaner REST API will expose a controller endpoint wrapping the existing RabbitBindingCleaner logic to allow triggering artifact cleanup via HTTP.
YARN deployer optimization will focus on caching shared module artifacts and optimizing staging file transfers to reduce deployment latency for streams.
Dependency upgrades (SHDP 2.2.1 GA, Spring Integration 4.2.2.GA, Spring Boot, and Spring Cloud Build) will be performed incrementally to isolate breaking changes and maintain backward compatibility.
Kafka bus partition key logic will be updated to evaluate key expressions independently of consumer instance count, ensuring native Kafka partitioning behavior even with a single downstream module.
assumptions: A single full-stack software developer will perform all design, coding, unit testing, integration testing, and documentation work.
Local or containerized test environments (Mesos, YARN, Kafka, RabbitMQ, HSQL DB) are available or easily mockable for developer testing.
Build tools (Maven/Gradle) and CI/CD pipelines are already established and require only configuration updates for dependency bumps.
No major API or database schema migrations are required beyond the requested enhancements and dependency upgrades.

activities.activity_description: Implement 'UNDEPLOYED' status in the Mesos SPI deployer module, update state mapping logic from Mesos task states, and add unit tests.

activities.activity_name: Rabbit Binder Cleaner REST API Endpoint (U2)
activities.activity_description: Create REST controller endpoint exposing RabbitBindingCleaner functions, write request/response DTOs, and add integration tests.
Optimize YARN stream and module deployment routines, streamline application master staging and localized artifact distribution, and verify speed improvements.
Update build configuration to SHDP 2.2.1 GA, adjust aligned Spring and Hadoop library versions, resolve compilation/compatibility issues, and verify Hive support.
Update Spring Integration dependency versions to 4.2.2.GA, verify messaging flow components, and fix any deprecated feature usages.

activities.activity_name: Kafka Bus Partitioning Key Expression Support (U6)
activities.activity_description: Modify Kafka binder logic to evaluate and apply partition key expressions even when target consumer module count is 1; add unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Upgrade Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Build Revisions (U7)
activities.activity_description: Bump Spring Boot and Spring Cloud parent/build plugin versions, adjust auto-configuration and build scripts, and re-test affected components.

activities.activity_name: Document HSQL DB Limitations for Composed Jobs (U8)
activities.activity_description: Author reference documentation section explaining HSQL DB concurrency and locking limitations when running composed job definitions.
Perform full test suite execution, end-to-end multi-module verification, and resolve any regressions introduced by dependency updates.
